'''Hend''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] who defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was eventually executed by the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Imperial Inquisition]].<ref name="SWG:ECH" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateImperialOfficer.png|thumb|right|250px|All possible depictions of Colonel Hend]]
Hend appeared appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CCHS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Colonel Hend was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:CCHS" />
